description: Defines the TaskModel class for interacting with 'tasks' in the database, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TaskModel
classes.description: Provides static methods for task CRUD operations in the database.

methods.name: createTask({ title, description, assignedTo, dueDate, parentId, templateId })
methods.description: Creates a new task with specified attributes and returns the inserted task object.

methods.name: getTasksForUser(userId, role, parentId)
methods.description: Retrieves tasks for a user, either all tasks for a parent or assigned tasks for a kid.

methods.name: updateTaskStatus(taskId, userId, role, newStatus)
methods.description: Updates the status of a task if performed by the assignee or parent.

methods.name: deleteTask(taskId, parentId)
methods.description: Deletes a task with the given task ID and parent ID.

methods.name: updateTask(taskId, parentId, updateFields)
methods.description: Updates specified fields of a task, only allowed for the parent.

ctags.name: createTask
ctags.pattern: /^  static async createTask({ title, description, assignedTo, dueDate, parentId, templateId }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ title, description, assignedTo, dueDate, parentId, templateId })

ctags.name: updateTaskStatus
ctags.pattern: /^  static async updateTaskStatus(taskId, userId, role, newStatus) {$/
